metadata.description: Approximate West Orange elementary attendance zones derived from the West Orange Board of Education Street Directory (revised June 5, 2026). Each street listed for a single elementary school was matched by name to OpenStreetMap street geometry; every point in the district was assigned to the school of the nearest such street, then clipped to the district boundary. Streets split between schools by house number were left out, so zone edges near those streets are approximate.
sources: West Orange Board of Education, Street Directory, revised 2026-06-05, https://www.woboe.org/departments/transportation/street-directory
OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), street geometry retrieved via Overpass API 2026-10-22
NJOGIS School Districts Unified for NJ (district boundary)
metadata.method_check: Agreement check, not an accuracy test: compared with the older NCES School Attendance Boundary Survey 2015-16 zones, 96.5% of OpenStreetMap street points on single-school directory streets fell inside the zone of the school the directory names, and 419 of 472 such streets fell entirely inside it. Disagreements can reflect boundary changes since 2015-16 as well as errors in this method. Computed once in a browser session on 2026-10-22; not reproducible from this repository alone.
